vision: A future where every Guard family is supported by a connected community—and the strength of those families is recognized as essential to readiness and retention.
mission: Support Guard-connected kids and caregivers with experiences, resources, and trusted relationships that build resilience and stability at home.

strategicInfrastructure.title: Work with local partners
strategicInfrastructure.description: We work with organizations across Iowa to bring events closer to families and connect them with resources they can use at home or at school.

strategicInfrastructure.title: Help families find their next step
strategicInfrastructure.description: We share what’s coming up, what to expect, and who to contact with questions. We also help families learn about opportunities beyond our events, including camps and Yellow Ribbon programs.

strategicInfrastructure.title: Pay attention to what helps
strategicInfrastructure.description: We pay attention to who we’re reaching and ask families what helped and what made it hard to come. Their answers shape what we plan next.

strategicInfrastructure.title: Speak up for Guard families
strategicInfrastructure.description: We share what families tell us with partners and Guard leaders so they can see what’s helping and where families still need support.

visionDetails: We want the kids who grow up with CYP to become teens that younger kids look up to. By graduation, we hope they’re proud of growing up in a Guard family and have found their own way to honor their parent’s service and give back.
We want Guard leaders to see what families make possible. When families have people to lean on, it helps service members stay ready and keep serving.

coreValues.title: Belonging
coreValues.description: There’s a place for every Guard family here. We’ll help you find your way when you walk into your first event.

coreValues.title: Connection
coreValues.description: It helps to know someone who gets it. At camp, a kid can meet a friend who knows what it’s like when a parent leaves for training or deployment.

coreValues.title: Leadership
coreValues.description: Leadership can start with an invitation. We ask teens to notice who’s on their own and help younger kids join in.

coreValues.title: Pride
coreValues.description: Guard kids have a story worth telling. We want them to see how much they’ve grown and recognize the part their family plays in serving.

coreValues.title: Service
coreValues.description: There are many ways to give back. We want young people to find theirs, whether they volunteer with CYP, speak up for Guard families, or choose to serve in the military.
